notes: Body dimensions are Apple published specs (height x width x depth, bare phone, no case).

camera_notch_* is a deliberately oversized keep-out window measured from the camera corner (top-left when viewing the back of the phone). Leaked/mockup data puts the 14 Pro Max bump at ~37-40 mm square; verify with calipers before printing.
control_side_wall_mm limits how far the cradle side wall climbs on the right-hand edge (viewed from front) so it does not press the 16 Pro Camera Control button. Verify on the real phone.
